description: Analytical models implemented by AIP's own engines (packages/analytics). Each is registered as an ml_model master row; runs record their metrics in aip.model_run and their results in aip.model_output.

models.name: Hybrid solar generation forecast
models.algorithm: Physics chain baseline + gradient-boosted residual trees (squared loss for q50, pinball loss for q10/q90) + split conformal calibration
models.feature_set: physics output / capacity, lead time, time of day (sin, cos), plant scale

models.name: Inverter anomaly detection
models.algorithm: Isolation Forest (200 trees, ψ = 256) on fleet-relative daily features; robust z-scores explain each anomaly
models.feature_set: yield ratio to plant median, conversion-efficiency delta, temperature rise, DC voltage ratio, downtime share
models.validation_method: Injected-fault recall on held-out telemetry; score stability across seeds
models.primary_metric: Recall of injected faults at the anomaly threshold

models.name: Plant performance drift
models.algorithm: Two-sided tabular CUSUM (k = 0.5σ, h = 5σ) on the daylight performance residual
models.validation_method: Detection delay and false-alarm rate on simulated shifts

models.name: Asset life model
models.algorithm: Right-censored maximum likelihood: Weibull (profile likelihood), lognormal, exponential; chosen per asset class by AICc; bootstrap intervals
models.feature_set: operating hours at failure or censoring, failure flag, asset class
models.validation_method: AICc model selection; bootstrap 90 % intervals; recovery of known parameters on simulated data

models.name: Remaining useful life and failure probability
models.algorithm: Conditional reliability of the class life model at the asset's age, with a proportional-hazards condition multiplier exp(γ(1 − health/100))
models.feature_set: asset age, asset class, health score
models.validation_method: Bootstrap 90 % intervals on the failure probability; class life models checked by AICc and on simulated data with known parameters
models.primary_metric: Failure probability over the horizon, with its interval

models.name: Composite asset risk
models.algorithm: Expected loss = P(failure in horizon) × (lost generation × tariff + repair cost) × safety weight; saturating 0–100 score on governed bands
models.feature_set: failure probability, rated MW, capacity factor, outage hours (MTTR + part lead time), tariff, repair cost
models.validation_method: Spearman rank agreement with the expert risk queue on the assets both score

models.name: Battery state-of-health forecast
models.algorithm: Plan-relative fade ratio from capacity tests, shrunk to the fleet average; SoH(t) = 100 − k·(100 − plan(t))
models.feature_set: capacity tests, OEM degradation plan, daily equivalent full cycles, warranty terms
models.validation_method: Leave-last-test-out error on the capacity tests
models.primary_metric: Absolute error of predicted SoH at the held-out test (percentage points)

models.name: Revenue at risk
models.algorithm: 2,000 correlated draws (daily common factor) from the probabilistic generation forecast plus Bernoulli asset outages; energy × tariff
models.feature_set: q10/q50/q90 per interval, tariff, asset failure probabilities and outage hours
models.validation_method: Seeded reproducibility and percentile ordering; tested on synthetic horizons

models.name: Spare-part demand and stocking policy
models.algorithm: Croston, SBA and TSB against the mean on a time-ordered holdout; reorder point = rate·L + z·σ·√L by criticality service level
models.feature_set: daily part demand from executed interventions, lead time, criticality, stock position

models.name: Reliability and maintainability (MTBF / MTTR)
models.algorithm: MTBF = exposure hours / failures (life history); MTTR = mean resolution hours of completed corrective work orders; inherent availability
models.feature_set: life-history exposure and failures, corrective work-order resolution hours
models.validation_method: Failures, exposure and repair counts reported per class with each estimate
